rows.text: # Encoding/access carrier and authority inventory — revision 1

2026-09-11. DRAFT; no public shape acceptance or allocation. The mathematical controls
are independently qualified in ENCODING_ACCESS_MATH_REVIEW_REV1.json. Their operands
do not acquire evidence authority from that qualification.
## Settled reuse and necessary extensions

| Obligation | Reuse | Required extension / rejected shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| Selected source | SelectedEvidenceView534 contains selected bindings224 and claims240, ObserverId and selection occurrence1143 | Transfer the live selected capability to encoding, replacing the terminal diagnostic consumer in a new profile. Do not attempt to reuse a consumed capability or turn the public audit into a resolver. |
| Episode address | CharacterId through PRJ/IDN; SelectionOccurrenceId already uniquely identifies the selected source | Proposed key is (qualified CharacterId, SelectionOccurrenceId). No MemoryEpisodeId, duplicate experience allocation or bare counter-derived concept identity. |
| Retained historical content | Exact selected carrier is the observer-safe content authority | Proposed episode value embeds its EncodingEvidence once. No full unselected SEM, truth event or archive pointer. Immutability applies to that historical content, not to a separate presentation-history leaf. |
| Strength | EAM exact factors and named budget laws | Factor provenance must identify actual admitted inputs. The first homogeneous-prior control may use one uniform calibration; it must not claim observed category evidence. No category inferred from ID text or role inferred from missingness. |
| Association address | Existing PerceptualReferentId212 is the observer-relative continuant identity | Reuse it for row/column keys inside a qualified owner. Do not invent ConceptId aliases or equate fresh files merely because they occupy the same sensor port. |
| Cross-event continuity | SEM-001A admits fallible continuation hypotheses | New visible-marker profile: compare actual admitted glyph readouts, reject ambiguous matches, reuse a unique observer file. Persist only the needed observer-safe marker-to-file tracking evidence under perception authority. Marker swaps must permit wrong tracking across actual objects. This is a proposed tracking algorithm, not an amendment of SEM identity meaning. |
| Context/residual membership | Existing SEM roles include Location but not Cause/Incidental | A proposed positive observer-safe context-membership projection must be specified separately. Unresolved role is not residual membership. A residual-by-Location alternative would have a distinct name and cannot be presented as the historical Incidental rule. |
| Formation writes | Existing logical episodic-memory family and WRT Set with expected absence | New physical typed episode leaf, sole encoding writer and key/source equality. Existing measurement episode schemas stay unchanged and can coexist under separate physical leaves. |
| Association writes | Existing logical associations family, exact state/ownership framework | New typed row/edge storage and sole consolidation writer. EAM returns proposals only. Per-entry quantization and overflow trace must correspond to the committed prior snapshot. |
| Retrieval opportunity | Existing generated-source/parent association discipline | Cue comes from new actual permitted observation and current observer file, never a caller-authored list of remembered IDs. The exact permissible candidate index/read domain must be declared; no generic archive query. |
| Retrieval scoring | EAM recency/history, mean associative pull and canonical ranking | Qualified owner plus exact complete finite candidate set; nonexistent, foreign and withheld episodes cannot enter a ranker. Read-only ranking does not append a presentation. |
| Reinforcement | Existing sparse state/WRT framework | Separate presentation-history writer after successful retrieval, authentic occurrence binding and once-only update. Preserve episode bytes. Explicit duplicate/same-instant policy; no accidental extra history from restore or retries. |
| Later affect | Actual task-appraisal-affect/0.1-candidate produces transient TaskConcern | New authenticated delayed carriage may retain that exact producer output in scheduled work. It is not a public authored intensity and does not imply persistent mood. Its mapping to capacity/accessibility must be separately declared and contrasted with disabled feedback. |
## Proposed stages, not assigned phases or record numbers

Actual permitted scene → observation/tracking/classification → selected carrier
→ encoding factor calculation → EncodingEvidence → subject projection → episode
formation and association consolidation. Later actual permitted cue → owner projection
→ bounded candidate reads → exact activation/accessibility → recollection output
→ separately owned presentation reinforcement. Later genuine concern may bias only
the future permitted transformations; never rewrite historical selected content.

Reuse existing phase40 active control, phase130 consolidation and separate ordered
stages only after the complete symbolic dependency graph is reviewed. A proposal
cannot require a same-event belief read/write or manufacture a phase150 event.
Routes, StateFamilyRegistry materialization, registration/input/output identities,
accessors and complete-prefix replay must be closed together before allocation.
## Adversarial review conclusions

The first sketch must not store one monolithic graph as an ungoverned map, derive
owner from ObserverId text, turn selection ID into an episode counter, or clone full
SEM into each episode. Do not quantize encoding factors merely because association
weights live on a lattice. Activation b, encoding z and retrieval score are distinct.
Missing cue keys are not silently known-zero evidence; candidate index completeness
is part of the admitted read contract. Unknown affect is not zero concern.

The generic memory lifecycle (fragmentation, reconstruction, importance and progressive
consolidation) remains a separate MEM obligation; attention closure cannot retire it.
Conversely, a deterministic cue/strength probe must not be blocked on implementing
all biography or identity consolidation. The final coverage argument must explain
which memory obligations can change the ATTENTION comparisons rather than claiming
an unlimited human-memory result.
## Next construction work

First qualify the observed-marker continuity adapter using actual SEM tracking and
false-tracking controls; freeze its source semantics before public records. Then
complete positive context membership and owner/source/cue relationships. Only then
freeze the whole public encoding/access inventory, separate allocation and exact
model family. Corpus promotion remains last, with the original full ATTENTION intake
requirements preserved.
# Encoding/access public inventory — revision 2

2026-09-11. DRAFT, not whole-shape accepted. This replaces revision1's proposed
storage sketch, not any accepted contract. No numeric allocation or public runtime
activation. The user has authorized autonomous resolution of the remaining design
and review work; no permission request is pending.
## Executed findings and their limits

The actual selected-capability encoder has eight passing tests and five detected
source faults (SELECTED_ENCODING_REVIEW_REV1.json). It consumes only selected SEM
binding/claim bytes, preserves their existing refs and computes exact factors. Need
and surprise are explicitly disabled. It has no subject, state or public provenance
authority. Its three-unit uniform-prior case has total raw <=9/10, so it cannot
exercise shared-budget1 normalization; do not promote that comparison as evidence
against footprint dependence. EAM's independent arithmetic witnesses do exercise it.

Actual SEM marker tracking has nine tests and six faults after the dense-list
structural correction. Positive spatial allocation has eight tests and five faults.
SpatialPeripheral is a geometric classification, not CausalRole Incidental. The
historical residual-membership control remains separately owed. These independently
qualified components cannot be glued together by supplying new fields to the old
closed SelectedView.

Inspection of compileRequiredProjections shows a concrete integration gap: it admits
272/318, the exact EMB registrations465/469/470, or receiving515. Attention541 is
not admitted. A future encoder cannot call the base constructor with541 or read the
roster directly. A successor registration/admission adapter must bind its exact
payload schema and invoke the same PRJ/IDN requirement algorithm with its own actual
admitted-input capability. No fake base wrapper or duplicate observer roster.

Inspection of StateModel/ContractReadProjection shows another concrete gap: direct
and derived reads cover named paths. AuthoritativeState.entries() is not a declared
character candidate-query capability. A wildcard in ReadDomain alone does not earn
unlogged enumeration. The inventory therefore chooses bounded governed owner leaves
instead of an auxiliary candidate index or a scan of arbitrary episode keys.
## Proposed storage refinement
Three separate physical leaves, all keyed by the actual qualified CharacterId:

1. EpisodeLedger: at most four entries in formation order. Each entry has the
   existing SelectionOccurrenceId and exact EncodingEvidence once. Insertion appends
   one previously absent selection; every previous entry remains byte-identical.
   Only authority/attention-episode-formation writes this leaf. Empty selections
   create no episode. No episode ID is allocated. The semantic address remains
   (CharacterId, SelectionOccurrenceId), now inside a bounded governed owner value.
2. AssociationGraph: at most12 distinct PerceptualReferentId keys in canonical order,
   exact lattice rows, and LastUpdatedAt. Only authority/attention-association-update
   writes it. A row is explicit and the matrix dimension, zero diagonal, quantization
   and row bounds are validated. This is a typed bounded record, not an ungoverned
   string map. New nodes come only from newly encoded selected evidence; prior node
   identities never change meaning. Whole-owner graph reads are exact logged reads.
3. PresentationLedger: at most four entries keyed by existing SelectionOccurrenceId,
   each with at most eight nondecreasing presentation times. Only a separate
   authority/attention-presentation-update writes it, both for initial encoding and
   later successful recollection. Episode formation does not write this leaf.
   No global event archive or redundant candidate index exists.

EpisodeLedger and PresentationLedger materialize distinct physical leaves of the
existing logical episodic-memory family; AssociationGraph materializes associations.
Every write has expected-old checks and its exact authority. Existing measurement
memory leaves, key shapes, accessors and histories remain unchanged. The bound12
fits EAM's frozen32-node domain; exceeding it rejects rather than truncates. Removal,
fragmentation and long-horizon compaction remain MEM extensions, not silently retired.

The single-owner values make completeness testable: recall reads exactly the subject's
whole EpisodeLedger, AssociationGraph and PresentationLedger via three fixed
declared accessors. It may not derive subject from their contents. Every ledger
entry is validated against its key/owner/evidence and every history key must match
one episode. The authoritative stage ordering must ensure these invariants at every
successful instant; an interrupted intermediate stage is never a save prefix.
## Proposed causal graph and carriers

Formation: actual safe observation → actual SEM interpretation → selected view →
pure factor calculation → EncodingEvidence → required subject projection → episode
append → association update → initial presentation update.

Recall: a later actual observation → actual observer-relative marker continuation
→ cue extraction → required subject projection → exact owner-leaf reads → activation
and accessibility → Recollection → presentation update. No caller-supplied episode
list, remembered file ID, activation vector or presentation count is admitted.

EncodingEvidence needs an exact new canonical shape containing the existing selected
envelope534 once, derived factor rows and committed calibration references. It gains
no second occurrence merely for wrapping a SelectionId. Its row provenance references
the carried original bindings/claims. The old selected-only capability is transferred
to this consumer; the terminal diagnostic does not also consume it.

A generated RecallOpportunity needs ObserverId and the actual permitted cue output.
It has scheduler identity and exact parent binding; no CueId. The cue means a current
perceived file match, not recognition of a true entity. For a cue file absent from
the graph, record NoKnownAssociationMatch. Do not confuse that with an unavailable
cue. Candidate episodes and their known graph keys stay complete in either case.
Exact retrieval produces a new Recollection occurrence only when K>0 and an episode
is selected; output includes retained historical bytes and score determinants.
Score calculation is read-only. Subsequent presentation updates are separately
identified by the actual committed recollection output and cannot run twice.

Encoding calculation is current-event processing. State consolidation is proposed
at phase140, matching the existing memory ownership precedent; successive registered
stages use scheduler parent ordering. Later recall occurs at a strictly later instant
and performs no same-event belief read/write. The complete graph, route closure,
phase legality, work/output/occurrence bounds and failure rollback must be frozen
before acceptance. Phase150 remains nonschedulable. Ordinary memories do not bypass
OutcomeEvaluation→CharacterLearningEvidence or redefine that separate EVID slice.
## Source and feedback gates still open

- Public observation must carry actual permitted glyph and coordinate readouts,
  feature availability and supporting observation identity. A component input is
  not an authenticated source. A governed profile must bind coordinates to actual
  physical observations while keeping hidden object identity trace-side.
- The first three-port source cannot simply admit new SEM feature IDs, new causal
  derivation functions or extra selected-view alternatives. Such source extensions
  need their exact schema/version, evidence scope and output closure.
- Spatial allocation and role allocation remain separate named models. No claim
  that one earns reduction of the historical Incidental control is made. Role/cause,
  relevance and evidence-aware surprise still need their named source dispositions.
- TaskConcern is current-event producer output. A later feedback opportunity must
  carry the authentic earlier output through scheduled causal edges in the same
  run, preserve its original provenance and reject future/foreign/replayed claims.
  No persistent mood family or caller-authored concern value is implied. Unknown
  concern stays unavailable, not numeric zero. The modulation law needs its own
  fixed calibration and disabled-feedback comparator.
- Exact registration/admission/PRJ extension, symbolic schema table, leaf/value roles,
  occurrence/output rules, finite model recipe and whole-prefix replay remain to be
  specified together. Do not allocate a partial table from this sketch.
## Adversarial review of the refinement

This resolves candidate enumeration without inventing an index or using private
state.entries() as a character read. It also avoids two writers on initial versus
retrieval presentation history. It does not resolve source authentication, whole
registration shape or later affect merely by drawing their arrows. Four episodes
are a bounded attention experiment horizon, not a universal memory capacity.

Required faults include: read foreign owner before qualification; omit an owner
ledger entry from candidates; insert a cue ID from truth; reinforce during ranking;
reinforce twice on replay; rewrite an old episode on append; mutate graph through
the episode writer; use current concern to modify its producing appraisal; admit an
unknown cue as observed zero; normalize independent focal encoding across unrelated
selected units; and use shared-budget comparisons entirely below their threshold
while claiming the normalization branch was tested.

Next: finish the observer-safe source and delayed feedback contracts, then one whole
symbolic schema/declaration packet. Component qualification remains useful evidence
but cannot substitute for these gates. General ATTN and corpus promotion stay OPEN.
# General attention registry member shape

LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required. Symbolic proposal only. Existing
namespace families are reused; no permanent member is assigned by this document.

Name the67 already reviewed stage templates with distinct transition/event/seam
members under `general-attention-`. Names identify fixed implementations, not new
psychological distinctions or schedulable phases. A seam member alone grants no
authority: exact version and full declaration remain model-governed.

The eight accessor members implement the accepted owner/derived view inventory.
Character selectors require actual PRJ/IDN; observer selectors use the admitted
ObserverId. Derived event/body views omit retention metadata and retain provenance.
Available cue gating precedes those reads. Missing initialized leaves reject.
There is no cognitive local-reserve or formation-protocol accessor.

Six authority members cover four distinct cognitive owners, the noncognitive
formation hook and the qualified local physical reserve owner. Exact root/path
authorization must be compiled independently. Existing perception authority may
cover the new observer windows only through an explicit new model authorization;
old authority declarations do not gain these paths retroactively.

The already proposed maintenance-goal kind and qualification predicate remain
distinct from character qualification and from spec/content/holder coupling. One
closed registry envelope kind admits exact declaration schemas; no callbacks.

The machine proposal exhaustively lists these218 members, eight accessor paths and
six owner scopes. This is representational naming of accepted boundaries. Preserve
the alternative of sharing implementation code behind distinct declarations; do
not merge authority or evidence boundaries for naming convenience. Public admission,
exact instances, model bytes and General Attention remain OPEN.
# General attention carrier checkpoint
2026-09-13. LOCAL DISPOSITION — continue; no owner ruling required. GA remains OPEN.

The bounded163-record carrier shape is accepted and its separate numeric gate passes.
RecordTypeIds542..704,523 field ordinals,38 field-local finite tag sets,11 record unions
and six namespaces1044/1045/1145..1148 are permanently frozen by
`GENERAL_ATTENTION_CARRIER_ALLOCATION_MANIFEST.json` in formal. The allocation audit
rejects16 faults and preserves20 prior allocation tables. This does not freeze registry
members, exact model instances, contextual admission or public execution.

The actual codec composes the separate attention and embodied-receiving registries.
The first test run found that attention alone lacks EMB; revision2 fixes that omission
without modifying either inherited codec or any old bytes. Ten codec tests and eight
source substitutions protect schema, namespace, union, collection, context and inherited
domain boundaries. Structural decoding grants no public capability.

Canonical recall projection now preserves acquisition/selection identity, observer,
formation time, transformation version and surviving event/body evidence while erasing
retention protection metadata. Five tests cover both partitions, invalid siblings,
strict prior time and detached output. Canonical body production wraps the actual
selector and one-use formation capability: four actual-source tests protect zero
capacity, absence, identity distinction, context carriage and capability reuse.
Eight further source substitutions protect the body/projection boundary.

Evidence: GA_PRODUCTION_BOUNDARIES_REGRESSION_REV8 passes314 tests/46 files;
GA_CANONICAL_RECALL_PROJECTION_TESTS_REV2 adds five tests and
GA_CANONICAL_BODY_PRODUCTION_TESTS_REV1 adds four. Typecheck, reference-boundary
and whitespace checks pass. These are component/codec results, not public GA proof.
Failed development receipts remain preserved. Frozen corpus0.27.0 is unchanged.

Continue with exact registry-member/accessor/registration closure and model packaging,
then actual public source/subject/output ownership, whole-B0 rollback/replay and corpus
promotion. The inherited concern-source result retains its public/component split;
no same-run GA feedback qualification is inferred. Missing-facet controls remain
component/profile exclusion. No genuine architectural fork has been encountered.
# General attention component checkpoint

2026-09-11. Primary-agent implementation and adversarial self-review under the user's
autonomous-work authorization. **General ATTN remains OPEN.** This is an intermediate
checkpoint; no new user decision is needed to continue the public contract work.

The current [receipt](GENERAL_ATTENTION_COMPONENT_QUALIFICATION_REV1.json) records
72 passing tests across11 files:49 new component/composition tests and23 retained
selection/public boundary tests. Twenty-eight current-source faults are detected.
TypeScript and the reference import boundary pass. The prior bounded-public verifier
still validates32 models,224 specimens,434 restores and453 preserved EMB fingerprints.
This is targeted regression and preserved prior evidence, not a fresh whole-repository
test run or a new historical-reference test run.
## Implemented and reviewed

- Exact encoding, association quantization, spreading activation and accessibility
  math, with the actual historical independent/shared/hybrid/flat laws distinguished.
- Observer-relative marker matching using actual SEM tracking transitions, including
  wrong tracking and ambiguous/missing marker controls.
- Positive spatial allocation with unknown positions excluded from its residual pool;
  it makes no causal Incidental claim.
- Actual selected-capability consumption to role-derived encoding strengths, preserving
  selected SEM bytes and references and explicitly disabling need/surprise channels.
- Explicit denominator controls that exercise shared normalization and hybrid low-item
  footprint, plus selected encoding → association/access arithmetic comparisons.

For two versus three selected Actors, SmallBudget shared strength is1/2 versus1/3;
independent remains3/13. At association scale100, their focal edges are25/100 versus
11/100 and5/100 versus5/100 respectively. Flat tagging retains strength1 but its edge
changes1→1/2 through row competition. Encoding strength and association competition
therefore remain separately observable. The later access calculations are component
operands, not proof of an acquired public episode or an authenticated cue.

Adversarial review corrected sparse-list admission and mutable shared rational/role
objects. Earlier receipts remain historical; forward receipts bind the corrected
sources. The global ExactRational substrate and accepted old public models are unchanged.
## Next public contract work

The [revised inventory](ENCODING_ACCESS_PUBLIC_INVENTORY_REV2.md) identifies actual
PRJ registration and candidate-enumeration gaps. It proposes three bounded governed
owner leaves and a separate presentation writer, avoiding a generic archive scan or
duplicate candidate index. These storage shapes are still proposals.

The [source design](ATTENTION_ENCODING_SOURCE_DESIGN_REV1.md) specifies physical
glyph/position evidence, cross-event tracking and a new closed selected companion.
The [delayed concern design](ATTENTION_DELAYED_CONCERN_DESIGN_REV1.md) narrows actual
TaskConcern before downstream use. Its [join review](ATTENTION_FEEDBACK_JOIN_REVIEW_REV1.md)
requires an explicit two-parent scheduled join, subject equality and replay binding;
a private runtime cache is insufficient.

Complete their symbolic record/declaration/output graph and review it before separate
allocation, exact model packaging and public implementation. Then execute ownership,
encoding, retrieval, feedback, rollback/persistence and corpus comparisons. Historical
Incidental/Cause, category, realized Need and evidence-aware surprise obligations
remain explicitly open; these restricted components have not retired them.

No new canonical allocation, public model, ExperimentIdentity, phenomenon member or
corpus digest was created. Corpus0.27.0 stays current. This checkpoint does not fulfill
the user's requested General attention completion endpoint.
# General attention registration checkpoint
2026-09-13. LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required. GA remains OPEN.

The latest affected run, `GA_PRODUCTION_BOUNDARIES_REGRESSION_REV7.json`, passes
282 tests in42 files. TypeScript passes after correcting control-flow narrowing in
the new primitive validator; no runtime law changed in that correction.
Three concrete changes advance public packaging:

* Recall readers now project only the selected modality's surviving evidence and
  acquisition time/identity. Retention protection metadata is omitted before ranking.
  The actual source/recall fixtures use this projection. Its three source faults
  are detected by `GA_RECALL_PARTITION_REVIEW_REV1.json`.
* The graph now includes the previously omitted world-side local replenishment stage
  at110. Its actual result producer preserves prior/new anchors and exact inherited
  arithmetic, including zero-delivery reanchoring. Three source faults are detected
  by `GA_REPLENISHMENT_PRODUCTION_REVIEW_REV1.json`.
* The primitive validator enforces the declared exact rational, count, phase, time,
  version and lattice domains without choosing new identities or record shapes.
  Four source faults are detected by `GA_PRIMITIVE_GRAMMAR_REVIEW_REV1.json`.

Current symbolic packaging is topology revision2 (67 templates), output declarations
revision3, registration carrier revision2 and role crosswalk revision17 (163 records,
165 scalar positions,208 recursive boundaries). Their reviews detect12,14,9 and33
structural faults respectively. These static reviews are distinct from runtime tests.
All subject-projected input wrappers have the required direct ObserverId field;
inherited377 retains its existing subject projection. Registration reuses266 and322.

The [accessor proposal](GA_ACCESSOR_CLOSURE_REV1.md) distinguishes the full episodic
owner read from its two narrow recall projections and excludes physical/protocol
state from cognitive access. Exact canonical accessor compilation is still required.
## Remaining work

Continue locally with complete record/registration relations and whole model packaging,
including the inherited same-run concern producer, actual target schedules and work
ceiling. Only then proceed through the separate permanent allocation gate and public
adapter implementation. Public subject/source binding, state patches, common-B0 owner
composition, traces, each-stage rollback, replay and corpus qualification remain OPEN.
The67 templates are not an event-work bound and do not include every inherited producer.

No existing corpus bytes, permanent IDs, canonical model bytes or reference source
were changed. No owner ruling is pending; the omitted physical stage was an
implementation completeness correction, not a new architectural mechanism.

limits: Planning and captured hashes do not establish completed replay; later qualifications preserve component/native distinctions.
Later bounded completion supersedes routing only within named profiles, not all ideal-loop phenomena.
No runtime/test/build rerun, source gap closure, law/model/verdict/corpus/obligation status change or historical adequacy claim.
